title: Hanasato Minori — Can We Be Friends?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I managed to get up early again today! Time to practice my hardest!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to put on a really wonderful show for the owner and everybody. So, I need to give it everything I have!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Tsukasa's portrayal of Nyantaro is really amazing... Which means I have to keep finding ways to get better!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... The owner's cat is also named Nyantaro, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I still haven't had a chance to meet him yet. I hope I get to soon...!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Morning, Minori!
You're here really early today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Morning, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I wanted to practice on my own before everyone else got here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same. I want to make sure I'm able to keep up with Kusanagi during the show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, you sound so motivated!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, why don't we practice together while we wait for the others to get here?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
I actually wanted to talk about the scene where we both appear...
Meow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Huh?!
What was that...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I had a feeling it was you, Nyantaro.
Did you come to watch us practice today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is Nyantaro?!
H-He's so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
This is your first time meeting him.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I've been waiting for this moment since you guys have been talking so much about him...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh... I should start by introducing myself!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello, Nyantaro! I'm Minori Hanasato! It's so great to finally meet you!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Mrrow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Huh? He turned the other way...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's strange...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, was I too loud just now...?
I might've scared him. Sorry, let me try that again...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ahem...
I heard that you're friends with everyone, Nyantaro? Would you also like to be friends with me?

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: *Scowl*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh... Nyantaro...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: His eyes sure don't seem friendly...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, why...? You guys said that he's really friendly around people...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: He probably just needs more time to get to know you, Minori. I mean, how would you feel if a random stranger came up and introduced themselves to us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right...
Wait, if I can convince him that I'm not a threat...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! I just have to use that to become friends with him!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ta-daa! A foxtail! This is the secret weapon I found growing in the park!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, why do you have one of those?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I made sure to find one so I'd be ready to meet Nyantaro whenever!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This should help break the ice!
Come here, Nyantaro! Here kitty!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's play!
Look, the foxtail's swishing around!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: He seems totally uninterested...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This is pretty strange...
Why do you think he's ignoring you like this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, no...
What if I smell like Samo to him?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that'd certainly explain a lot.
I can understand why he's feeling wary now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But time should fix that...
You'll just have to wait until his smell wears off.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm sure you'll get to become friends with him once he sees that you're a trustworthy person.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, Minori, you're also doing your best to put on a great show and give the carnival the send-off it deserves. He'll come around in no time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, that means I gotta keep trying harder and harder! In order to become friends with Nyantaro!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just wait, Nyantaro!
This show's gonna be so unforgettable!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: *Ignore*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, he looked the other way again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
One way or another, we're gonna become friends...!
